content: MDXEditor (MIT, @mdxeditor/editor v4.0.4) is the leading WYSIWYG-with-markdown-output React editor in 2026, purpose-built for Notion/Google-Docs-like editing while storing clean markdown -- ideal for non-technical users editing SKILL.md bodies. Alternatives: Milkdown (more plugin flexibility, more setup), Tiptap (headless, needs custom markdown serialization), @uiw/react-md-editor (raw markdown + preview split, less WYSIWYG).
